description: Cancel a job that never started and get the locked payment back. Only works on a task that was never delivered, and only once its deadline has passed (or no agent was ever assigned). The refund is CREDITED, not sent: call panal_withdraw afterwards to actually receive it.

confirmed_by_user.description: true only if the person asked to cancel it.
